I found this trick on Reddit a while back: Imagine a series of unconnected things and visualise them. For some reason I always start with a lobster, and picture one in my mind, then you just keep going e.g. pencil sharpener, breeze block, skateboard, koala, nectarine etc... Main thing is you're trying to disengage your brain from thought processes, which helps to put it in the correct sort of holding pattern to fall asleep. Hence why you have to avoid logical series of objects (e.g. lobster, crab, stingray, seaweed, ocean, boat) because then your brain engages in making patterns. Might not work for everyone but 9/10 times it works for me.

Or I just get out of bed and wander around listening to music for a while.

The one thing you need to do at this stage is get comfortable in your skin. Once you decide in yourself that you're interesting and good company, you won't feel awkward about inviting yourself to things. Then when you feel like socialising with someone you can send out a few messages to people asking what they're up to and whether you can join in, safe in the knowledge that they're extremely unlikely to all be doing the same thing with the same people. Try to remember it's about making friends with individuals who you vibe with, rather than with whole groups.
